verdict.rationale: Workable's pricing page lists a first-party "Custom report builder", a reporting capability of the product itself. Nothing documents which funnel metrics it covers or how it slices them. API endpoints for stages, events and offers are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rates, per-role/per-team breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team
